title: Follow-up: apply faithful-or-absent adjudicated spans to non-effect members whose readiness clauses stay typed
description: Discovered in eshyra-o9bd.19.4.5.8: adjudicated readiness now supports sourceText, but operations whose only effect payload stayed typed (e.g. Nine Lives Stealer slay-on-critical.cost unconditional charge, Rod of Lordly Might drain-life/paralyze operation activation trigger 'melee hit with rod', Hammer giant-slaying-critical activation trigger, Ring of Shooting Stars launch op) still carry the broader wording on the operation side; owned by eshyra-o9bd.19.4.6 -- use applyAdjudicatedMagicItemEffects-style table or per-producer spans.
close_reason: Duplicate of eshyra-o9bd.19.4.6 (same faithful-or-absent scope for non-effect members); its examples were appended to that bead's notes.
